docs.title: Bug fixes
docs.text:
• add run-codeql false, container-suffix/tag for audit and test jobs, and Table of Contents to README
  • remove container-tag from audit and test jobs (not an accepted input)
  • add missing release job to cd.yml
  • remove audit and test jobs not required for shell repos
  • add PATH to readiness probe for user-installed tools

  • remove Go template syntax, make projects mount required Lima 2.1.1 cannot parse Go template control flow (if/end) at the YAML structural level. Remove the param block and conditional mount. The projects mount is now unconditional with a placeholder path that must be overridden via --set at create time.

  • move Claude Code install to system provisioning block npm install -g writes to /usr/lib/node_modules/ which requires root. Running in the user provisioning block caused EACCES, failing the readiness probe. Ref #27

docs.title: Features
docs.text:
• Lima VM template for vergil-agent Ubuntu 24.04 with rootless containerd, gh, uv, jq, yq, zsh, and developer convenience tools

  • build script for VM creation and testing Creates temporary Lima VM, runs test suite, cleans up. Located in scripts/ per project convention.

  • parameterized /projects mount point Replace hardcoded ~/dev mount with user-configurable hostProjectsDir param. Host path mounts at /projects inside the VM, making workspace paths deterministic and user-agnostic. Ref #19.

  • install Node.js and Claude Code in VM template Add Node.js 22 via NodeSource and Claude Code via npm to provisioning scripts. Add claude readiness probe and tool test. Ref #21

  • credential provisioning via vrg-vm-init vrg-vm-init reads identities.toml (or env var overrides), injects App ID and private key into the VM via limactl shell, configures git HTTPS rewriting, and installs vergil-tooling. Token acquisition is fully dynamic at runtime via vrg-git / vrg-gh wrappers.
